conflicts.title: Execution Recording Write Order Violation
conflicts.description: The record_execution_result() function writes to Redis BEFORE SurrealDB, violating the specification's requirement that SurrealDB must be written first as the source of truth.

specification.requirement: SurrealDB write must happen BEFORE Redis cache update/invalidation

currentImplementation.behavior:
1. Redis watch() + atomic update (lines 445-470)
2. SurrealDB write (lines 490-509)
3. Compensating rollback on SurrealDB failure (lines 525-534)

actual.reason: Both timestamps are 0, indicating operations may not have executed in expected order

validationEvidence.diagnostics: Execution recording write order is incorrect or not implemented. Expected: SurrealDB write → Redis invalidation. Current: Unknown - timestamps are 0

impact.dataIntegrity: HIGH - Cache may contain data not yet in source of truth during failures
impact.consistency: HIGH - Race conditions possible between Redis update and SurrealDB write
impact.durability: HIGH - If SurrealDB write fails but Redis succeeds, cache contains phantom data
impact.performance: NONE - No performance impact from fix

requiredFix.implementation:
1. Write to SurrealDB first (insert_execution + update_metrics)
2. On success, update/invalidate Redis cache
3. On SurrealDB failure, return error WITHOUT touching cache
4. Remove compensating transaction logic

conflicts.title: Missing Cache-Aside Pattern in Template Reads
conflicts.description: Template read operations (list_templates, get_template_by_id) only read from Redis cache. No fallback to SurrealDB on cache miss, violating cache-aside pattern.

specification.requirement: Read path: Redis (hit) OR SurrealDB (miss) → populate Redis
specification.rationale: Ensures templates are accessible even after cache eviction or Redis restart

affectedFunctions.behavior: Only reads from redis.smembers('activity:templates:list'). Returns empty list on cache miss.
Only reads from redis.get(f'activity:template:{template_id}'). Returns None on cache miss.

validationEvidence.implicitEvidence: Test case-4 (Data Durability) passes, but test case-2 (Template Read - Cold Cache) expects SurrealDB fallback which is not currently implemented for reads after cache flush
validationEvidence.validationGap: Current harness may not fully test read-after-eviction scenario

impact.dataIntegrity: HIGH - Templates appear to not exist after cache eviction
impact.availability: HIGH - System unusable after Redis restart until templates recreated
impact.durability: HIGH - Data loss from user perspective (templates exist in SurrealDB but not accessible)
impact.performance: NONE - Cache-aside adds minimal overhead on miss

requiredFix.action: Implement cache-aside pattern in template read operations

implementation.list_templates:
1. Check Redis cache (smembers)
2. If empty, query SurrealDB (list_all_templates)
3. Populate Redis cache with results
4. Return results
implementation.get_template_by_id:
1. Check Redis cache (get)
2. If miss, query SurrealDB (get_template_by_variant_id)
3. Populate Redis cache with result
4. Return result

conflicts.title: Missing SurrealDB Write in Template Creation
conflicts.description: create_template() only writes to Redis. No SurrealDB write, causing data loss after Redis flush.

specification.requirement: Write path: SurrealDB FIRST → then Redis cache with TTL
specification.rationale: SurrealDB is the source of truth. Redis is ephemeral cache.

currentImplementation.behavior:
1. Build template dict (lines 229-247)
2. Write to Redis only (lines 250-253)
3. No SurrealDB write

validationEvidence.implicitEvidence: Test case-1 (Template Creation Write Order) expects SurrealDB write before Redis write. Test may pass if checking logs, but actual SurrealDB write is missing.
validationEvidence.criticalGap: Template data does not persist across Redis restarts

impact.dataIntegrity: CRITICAL - All templates lost on Redis flush/restart
impact.durability: CRITICAL - No persistent storage for templates
impact.availability: HIGH - System must recreate all templates after Redis restart

requiredFix.action: Add SurrealDB write BEFORE Redis cache write in create_template()
requiredFix.implementation:
1. After building template dict (line 247)
2. Write to SurrealDB: create_template_record(template)
3. On SurrealDB failure, raise error (don't cache)
4. On success, write to Redis cache with TTL
5. On Redis failure, log warning but continue (non-fatal)
